QuestionStmt.S: Which from following is the most stable species?

Solution.S:
An alkyl group exerts electron releasing inductive effect (+I) which stabilizes positive charge on the atom bonded to it. As the number of alkyl groups increases from $NH_4^+$ to $R_3\overset{+}{N}H$, the positive charge on nitrogen becomes more stabilized. Hence the order of stability is:

$$NH_4^+ < R-\overset{+}{N}H_3 < R_2\overset{+}{N}H_2 < R_3\overset{+}{N}H$$

Thus $R_3\overset{+}{N}H$ is the most stable, which corresponds to option D.
